reviews.review: I want to like this game but too many QOL elements are missing.  There is no encyclopaedia - so what kind of goods does this train carry?  No way to know without buying a train.  You can hover over a train to know what its name is, but you can't hover over a wagon to know what goods it carries?  What does this switch do again?  Sorry, there is a train on it, you have to wait. You want to place a switch on a bridge, already occupied, sorry.  You want to place two switches at a location - no can do, occupied. There is so much frustration in this game that it doesn't have to right to call itself cozy. I'm disappointed, I bought this game because the dev made Farlanders which is a far better game that provides a wealth of information to the player.
reviews.developer_response: Hey, I'm sorry you found the game disappointing. In the recent update I added a small info section in the escape menu that shows info about type of cargo each carriage can carry. You can also temporarily hide trains by holding ALT, to access rail signals below trains. As for not allowing multiple rail signals per tile, it was my intentional decision because I didn't want to overcomplicate the interface (you'll need to cycle through signals) and visual clarity (multiple signals in one tile would be hard to read). Although I might be wrong, because you are not the first one missing this feature.
